name: Grandtop Yongxing Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Grandtop Yongxing Group Co.,Ltd engages in the waste-to-energy incineration business in China. The company provides biomass processing services, such as biomass treatment services for catering, kitchen, dead poultry and livestock, feces, and other biomass waste. It is also involved in the operation, technology research and development, incineration equipment manufacturing, flue gas production, and other businesses. Grandtop Yongxing Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 2009 and is based in Guangzhou, China. Grandtop Yongxing Group Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of GZ Environmental Protection Investment Group Co. Ltd.
